caption: A stick is dragged through a patch of loose gravel on a path, leaving a furrow behind it.

sa.check: A stick is dragged through a patch of loose gravel on a path.
A furrow is left behind it.
The furrow trails behind the stick, not ahead of it.

pc.expect: Small ridges of pushed-aside stones form on each side of the furrow as the stick moves.
pc.fail: The gravel closes behind like liquid; or the stick leaves no mark; or the stones fly up in a spray.

pc.expect: The furrow appears only where the stick has passed and stays.
pc.fail: It appears ahead of the stick; or closes up behind; or appears elsewhere.

pc.expect: The stick moves only as dragged and stones move only as pushed.
pc.fail: Stones move ahead of the stick; or the stick moves by itself; or stones rearrange after the stick has passed.
They hang; or rise; or float.

pc.expect: One stick keeps its number, and the stones keep theirs.
pc.fail: The stick duplicates; or stones vanish; or the stick passes through the path.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The path and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The gravel changes colour; or the path rearranges; or the stick changes.

note: The hand on the stick is kept as the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
